# Deskriptiv təhlil

```{r descriptive,include=TRUE,echo=TRUE,warning=FALSE,message=FALSE,error=FALSE}
map = readRDS("fp_map (1).rds")
rec = readRDS("fp_receipts.rds")
qara = readRDS("qara.rds")
ag = readRDS("ag.rds")

# statistik xulase;
summary(map)
summary(rec)
summary(qara)

# sutun adlari;
names(map)
names(ag)

# umumi satis hecmi;
umumi_satis_hecmi = qara %>% 
  summarise(sum(Total))

# Muxtelif pos(satis menteqesi) sayi;
dist_pos_number = qara %>% 
  distinct(pos) 

# Bir gun ortalama ne qeder gelir elde edilib; 
dis_day_number <- rec %>%
  summarise(dis_day_number = n_distinct(rec_date)) 
  
profit_per_day = umumi_satis_hecmi/dis_day_number

# Food ve Non-food mehsul sayi;

sales <- ag %>% 
  mutate(month = month(rec_date)) %>%
  group_by(product_type, month) %>% 
  summarise(total_sales = sum(Total, na.rm = TRUE),
            .groups = "drop") %>%
  group_by(month) %>%
  mutate(
    percentage = total_sales / sum(total_sales) * 100,
    label = paste0(comma(total_sales), "\n(", round(percentage), "%)")
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

ggplot(sales,
       aes(x = factor(month), y = total_sales)) +
  geom_col(fill = "#1560BD", color = "dark blue", width = 0.7) +
  geom_text(aes(label = label), 
            vjust = -0.3, 
            size = 3.5,
            color = "#0d3b66",
            fontface = "bold") +
  facet_wrap(~product_type) +
  labs(title = "Satış",
       x = "Ay",
       y = "Ümumi satış") +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = comma, expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.15))) +
  theme_minimal()

```

# Proqnoz ve ferziyyeler

```{r proqnoz ve ferziyyeler,include=TRUE,echo=TRUE,warning=FALSE,message=FALSE,error=FALSE}
# Load libraries
library(tidyverse)
library(ggplot2)

# Build the model
financial_model <- lm(Total ~ unit_price + qnt + product_type + hefte_gunu + period2, 
                      data = ag)  

# View results
summary(financial_model)

# Extract key statistics
financial_stats <- data.frame(
  Metric = c("R²", "Adj R²", "F-statistic", "p-value"),
  Value = c(
    round(summary(financial_model)$r.squared, 4),
    round(summary(financial_model)$adj.r.squared, 4),
    round(summary(financial_model)$fstatistic[1], 2),
    format(pf(summary(financial_model)$fstatistic[1], 
              summary(financial_model)$fstatistic[2], 
              summary(financial_model)$fstatistic[3], 
              lower.tail = FALSE), scientific = TRUE)
  )
)

# Add predictions to data
ag$predicted_total <- predict(financial_model)

# Create plot
ggplot(ag, aes(x = Total, y = predicted_total)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.4, color = "#5bc0de", linewidth = 2) +
  geom_abline(intercept = 0, slope = 1, color = "#d9534f", 
              linetype = "dashed", size = 1.2) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = TRUE, color = "#2c3e50", fill = "#ecf0f1") +
  labs(
    title = "Model Dəqiqliyi: Faktiki vs Proqnoz Gəlir",
    subtitle = sprintf("R² = %.2f%% | RMSE = %.2f",
                       summary(financial_model)$r.squared * 100,
                       sqrt(mean((ag$Total - ag$predicted_total)^2))),
    x = "Faktiki Gəlir",
    y = "Proqnozlaşdırılan Gəlir",
    caption = "Qırmızı xətt = mükəmməl proqnoz | Mavi xətt = model proqnozu"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold")) 

```

# Xulase

```{r xulase,include=TRUE,echo=TRUE,warning=FALSE,message=FALSE,error=FALSE}
weekdays_table = ag %>% 
  group_by(hefte_gunu) %>% 
  summarise(total = sum(Total))

ggplot(weekdays_table, aes(x = hefte_gunu, y = total)) +
  geom_col(fill = "#3498db", width = 0.7, alpha = 0.9) +
  geom_text(aes(label = scales::comma(total)), 
            vjust = -0.5, size = 4.5, fontface = "bold", color = "#2c3e50") +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::comma_format(), 
                     expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.1))) +
  labs(
    title = "Həftənin Günlərinə Görə Satış Həcmi",
    subtitle = "Hansı günlər ən çox satış gətirir?",
    x = "Həftənin Günü",
    y = "Ümumi Satış",
    caption = "Mavi ton: yüksək aktivlik"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold", color = "#2c3e50"),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 12, color = "#34495e"),
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, size = 11, color = "#2c3e50"),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 11, color = "#2c3e50"),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold", color = "#2c3e50"),
    panel.grid.major.y = element_line(color = "#ecf0f1", size = 0.5),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
    plot.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
    panel.background = element_rect(fill = "#f8f9fa", color = NA)
  )

top_products = ag %>% 
  group_by(product_name) %>% 
  summarise(sum=sum(qnt)) %>% 
  arrange(-sum) %>% 
  head(10)

ggplot(top_products, aes(x = product_name, y = sum)) +
  geom_col(fill = "#3498db", width = 0.7, alpha = 0.9) +
  geom_text(aes(label = scales::comma(sum)), 
            vjust = -0.5, size = 4.5, fontface = "bold", color = "#2c3e50") +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::comma_format(), 
                     expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.1))) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold", color = "#2c3e50"),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 12, color = "#34495e"),
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, size = 11, color = "#2c3e50"),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 11, color = "#2c3e50"),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold", color = "#2c3e50"),
    panel.grid.major.y = element_line(color = "#ecf0f1", size = 0.5),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
    plot.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
    panel.background = element_rect(fill = "#f8f9fa", color = NA))

# Option 1: Convert to percentage format
ag <- ag %>%
  mutate(profit_margin_pct = profit_margin * 100)

# Then recreate categories with the new column
ag <- ag %>% 
  mutate(marja_category = case_when(
    profit_margin_pct >= 200 ~ ">=200",
    profit_margin_pct >= 100 & profit_margin_pct < 200 ~ "100-200",
    profit_margin_pct >= 0 & profit_margin_pct < 100 ~ "0-100",
    profit_margin_pct >= -100 & profit_margin_pct < 0 ~ "-100-0",
    profit_margin_pct >= -200 & profit_margin_pct < -100 ~ "-200--100",
    profit_margin_pct < -200 ~ "<-200",
    TRUE ~ "NA"
  ))

# Create summary by category
marja_summary <- ag %>%
  group_by(marja_category) %>%
  summarize(count = n(),
            total_sales = sum(Total, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  arrange(marja_category)

# Plot with count
ggplot(marja_summary, aes(x = marja_category, y = count)) +
  geom_col(fill = "#3498db", width = 0.7, alpha = 0.9) +
  geom_text(aes(label = scales::comma(count)), 
            vjust = -0.5, size = 4.5, fontface = "bold", color = "#2c3e50") +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::comma_format(), 
                     expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.1))) +
  labs(
    title = "Mənfəət Marjası Kateqoriyalarına Görə Paylanma",
    subtitle = "Hər kateqoriyada neçə tranzaksiya var?",
    x = "Marja Kateqoriyası (%)",
    y = "Tranzaksiya Sayı"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold", color = "#2c3e50"),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 12, color = "#34495e"),
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 0, hjust = 0.5, size = 11, color = "#2c3e50"),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 11, color = "#2c3e50"),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold", color = "#2c3e50"),
    panel.grid.major.y = element_line(color = "#ecf0f1", linewidth = 0.5),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
    plot.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
    panel.background = element_rect(fill = "#f8f9fa", color = NA)
  )
```
